observations.test: G09 copy migration rollback restore and bounded workload preserve meaningful data without approving production targets
observations.action: copy migration rollback restore and bounded workload preserve meaningful data without approving production targets
observations.observed: A meaningful disposable database containing actual prior named work is migrated on a supported backup copy and compared table by table. The source and rollback copy remain unchanged, recovery verifies logical records and exact original bytes, and twelve scoped reads at concurrency two produce engineering timings without claiming an approved representative target or deployment.

observations.test: G01 connected acceptance binds named declarations, exact terms and independent decisions through revision and restart
observations.action: current standard intake through named declarations, manual rule assessment, exact written terms, independent acceptance, changed independence position and persisted retry
actors: named external declarant via signed original
observations.observed: Unknown enquiry facts survive. Named team members declare for themselves; an external signed original retains person/content/scope/date/hash. A generic safeguard cannot waive a prohibition. Reviewed assessment, firm-reviewed proposal, sending, written agreement, acceptance and activation are distinct. A later disclosure causes deferral and renewed review while retaining earlier decisions, original bytes and revoked-access denials after restart. Firm/partner tenure and service restrictions are manually assessed against explicitly supplied test policy evidence, not an automatically verified legal rule.

observations.test: G00 shared foundations preserve scoped work, exact evidence and approval history through change and restart
observations.action: G00 two-engagement foundation reference through exact review, changed basis, revoked access and persisted retry
observations.observed: Two scoped engagements retain independent revisions and original-file identity. Self-review, wrong-scope originals, stale writes and conflicting retries are denied. Task completion does not approve work. Changed statements stale only the dependent authorization while preserving signed work, prior authorized bytes and the untouched second engagement. Revoked direct reads and cached-command replay remain denied after restart.

observations.test: two engagements isolate revisions, work, reports, grants and archive access
observations.observed: Wrong engagement rejected, removed membership revokes access, request retry is scope-bound, independent archive packages persist.
